reason: Both are US healthcare service providers paid by insurers and Medicaid, and both serve children. Their services differ. Pediatrix supplies hospital-based physician care: neonatal, maternal-fetal and pediatric subspecialty, under contracts with hospitals. Aveanna supplies in-home nursing, therapy and hospice. Pediatrix sells to hospitals and payers, while Aveanna sells to home patients and payers. The overlap is partial, so this is adjacent.
